reviewed: On the Quanta 40, jumper J7 selects the boot ROM source.
reword: Jumper J7 on the Quanta 40 selects the source of the boot ROM.
different: On the Quanta 40, jumper J9 enables the serial console at 9600 baud.

reviewed: A single 80mm fan cools the CPU heatsink on the Quanta 40.
reword: The Quanta 40's CPU heatsink is cooled by a single 80mm fan.
different: The fan connector on the Quanta 40 supplies 5 volts and a tachometer signal.

reviewed: The Quanta 40 uses electrolytic capacitors, not solid polymer, on the power rail.
reword: On the Quanta 40, the power rail uses electrolytic capacitors rather than solid polymer.
different: Capacitor C14 near the VRM occasionally bulges after decades of thermal cycling.

reviewed: The boot ROM on the Quanta 40 runs before any RAM is initialized.
reword: Before any RAM initializes, the Quanta 40's boot ROM runs first.
different: The boot ROM on the Quanta 40 is socketed for field replacement.

reviewed: The Quanta 40's SCSI bus requires termination on both end devices.
reword: Termination on both end devices is required by the Quanta 40's SCSI bus.
different: A loose SCSI terminator on the Quanta 40 causes spurious bus errors.

reviewed: Four SIMM slots on the Quanta 40 accept up to 64 megabytes.
reword: The Quanta 40's four SIMM slots accept up to 64 megabytes of RAM.
different: RAM slot 2 on the Quanta 40 is disabled when the math coprocessor is fitted.

reviewed: The Quanta 40's power supply delivers +5, +12, and -12 volts.
reword: +5, +12, and -12 volts are delivered by the Quanta 40's power supply.
different: The PSU fan on the Quanta 40 fails after roughly ten thousand hours.

reviewed: The Quanta 40 keyboard uses a round DIN connector with six pins.
reword: A round six-pin DIN connector is used by the Quanta 40 keyboard.
different: The keyboard connector on the Quanta 40 also carries a clock signal.

reviewed: The Quanta 40 monitor output uses separate horizontal and vertical sync signals.
reword: Separate horizontal and vertical sync signals are used by the Quanta 40's monitor output.
different: The monitor sync on the Quanta 40 accepts only negative-going pulses.

reviewed: A CR2032 battery backs the NVRAM on the Quanta 40 for ten years.
reword: The Quanta 40's NVRAM is backed by a CR2032 battery for ten years.
different: The NVRAM battery socket on the Quanta 40 corrodes if left drained.

reviewed: The Quanta 40 ships with a single 3.5-inch floppy drive at drive 0.
reword: Drive 0 on the Quanta 40 is a single 3.5-inch floppy drive.
different: The floppy drive on the Quanta 40 reads 1.44-megabyte disks natively.

reviewed: The Quanta 40 firmware lives in an EPROM under socket U12.
reword: Socket U12 on the Quanta 40 holds the firmware EPROM.
different: The Quanta 40 firmware checks the RAM count at every power-on self-test.
